text: Bitcoin has risen modestly at 1.5% while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 3.4% gain, signaling stronger buying interest in altcoins relative to BTC despite Bitcoin's dominant market share at 58.2%. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (50) with a -19 point decline over the past week, suggesting recent weakening sentiment even as prices hold steady. Volume at $98B is moderate, indicating traders are present but not rushing in aggressively, consistent with cautious consolidation rather than conviction-driven movement.
